svg.aria-label: F169.7 the sequence drawn for a phone: objects in memory
svg.title: F169.7 the sequence drawn for a phone: objects in memory

g.text: F169.7 the sequence drawn for a phone: objects in memory
Box: the whole width, at the top
a note: every request priced in the ledger
an answer: text, or a tool call
a call: run it, through the guards
a line has the colour of the box it leaves

text.tspan: What the layout hands back for the sequence on How it works, laid out 338 wide:
one list that holds its ten steps and its three frames. Four steps and two
frames are shown. A dashed line says which frame a part stands inside; the list holds them all itself.
